cues.text: Fibonacci is one member of a whole family of two-step rules.
Other coefficients and seeds give Lucas, Pell, even an oscillator.
The recorded values show it: three sequences grow, one cycles.
Stack two neighbors into a state, and one matrix, C, moves it forward.
The eigenvalues of C are its roots, and the larger one usually sets the growth.
When the two roots collide, the solution gains a factor linear in n.
Coefficients pick the rule, seeds the start, and roots the long run.
